title: Exact proper and open factors of the compactification projection
statement: For supplied operations and exchange data A over a compactified square Q [def-sf-operation-stages], define the middle object as p_*(j_!K tensor p^*N). Define properFactor as tensoring the support identification with N followed by the proper counit projection mate. Define openFactor as p_* of the specified open projection followed by inverse support identification. The projectionComponent of [def-sf-operation-stages] is exactly properFactor;openFactor, with equality transports at the middle object cancelling. For a coefficient comparison C and a natural tensorator t between the supplied tensor bifunctors, define middle as the direct-image comparison followed by p_* of the tensorator and of the open-extension and pullback comparisons. Its endpoints are inclusion of the first middle object and the middle object on the included inputs. The generic projection_preserved_of_factors theorem composes the two factor squares to preserve projectionComponent through the source and target endpoints of [lem-sf-rational-projection-tensor-compatibility]. Its proof is functoriality, the two given squares, and the proved factorization.
